_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: an open dice whose faces lie in a straight line; 2: views of a dice where the faces next to one face can be listed; 3: views turned about a shared face, a net folded round one face, or the cube that a net makes; 4: two rules used together, a box with a roof of triangles, or a net to choose from views. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
